text:
sara: Quick sync  we need to finalize which features are in MVP. Options: tenant SSO, embeddings cache, autoscale burst, in-console evals, model-pinning UI. What's the minimal demoable set that keeps our SLA promise?

alex: cut tenant SSO for MVP. Keep model-pinning UI and embeddings cache. Autoscale burst is config-only but needs runbook. Evals -> v1.

ravi: embeddings cache: low effort, big token saving (est 15-25%). Can land as a feature flag + 10% canary.

maggie: sales prefers to keep a story for enterprise; if SSO is cut, add "pilot SSO" messaging. In-console evals are a strong salesplay though.

ben: prioritize low-risk, high unit-economy wins. Agree embeddings cache is top.

sara: timeline: milestone freeze in 10 days (1749999999). Need eng signoff in 48h.

alex: will create canary + rollback plan in PR template.

ravi: will own cache implementation and metrics.

maggie: will update decks and release notes if we cut evals.

deploy-bot: Heads up: freeze in 10 days.

sara: action: eng signoff by 48h, PRs + canary runbooks, sales comms.

maggie: ack.

alex: ack.

ravi: ack.

ben: ack.

sara: closing thread once I post final cutlist.
